report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; three of four were 62-78ms and one was 344ms, with no 5xx and no dependency errors. The single slow sample is insufficient to establish any bounded root cause, and healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis. Handing off for baseline and longer-window evidence.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error evidence for /v1/checkout beyond a single 344ms sample (e.g., longer-window p95/p99 and error-rate series)
Dependency-level latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis to localize any slow hop
Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
